description: Imports the screens of an XML file on the serve host into the root screen folder of a CLASSIC WinCC HMI; a screen with the same name is OVERWRITTEN. WinCC Unified is refused (no file import in the V21 API). Returns the imported screen names. Maps to POST /hmi/{hmi}/screens/import {path}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

path.description: screen .xml file path on the serve host

name: tia_hmi_screens_import
title: TIA — import HMI screens (Classic)
